question: How much can a very experienced geologist earn per year in Australia?
answer: In Australia, geologists with great experience, around 5 to 10 years on the job, can reach 150,000 to 180,000 dollars gross a year. That is why the source video jokes, "let's all go to Australia!"
move: A seasoned geologist in Australia can top out at about $150–180k gross a year.
